description: Tracing an HTTPS request from an external client to an app pod via OVN-Kubernetes.

steps.description: Client initiates connection; HAProxy terminates TLS at the Route layer.
Traffic is forwarded into the OVN-Kubernetes host integration bridge.
OVS routes the packet through the host-side virtual Ethernet interface.
Packet crosses the boundary into the Pod's isolated Linux Network Namespace.
The application process (PID 1) accepts the cleartext socket connection.

description: Tracing the lifecycle of a new Pod being scheduled and started by the Kubernetes control plane.

steps.description: API Server receives a Pod creation request and notifies the Scheduler.
Scheduler selects a node and binds the Pod; Kubelet on the node is notified.
Kubelet instructs CRI-O to pull the container image and create the container.
CRI-O sets up cgroup resource limits for the new container.
CNI plugin provisions a new Network Namespace and assigns a Pod IP address.

description: Tracing a TCP connection between two pods on the same node via OVN-Kubernetes virtual switching.

steps.description: Source container sends a packet into its network namespace.
Packet exits the network namespace via the veth pair to the host.
OVS bridge receives the packet and evaluates OVN flow rules.
OVS forwards the packet through the destination pod's veth interface.
Packet arrives in the destination pod's network namespace and is delivered.
